description: This PHP class 'HtmlResponseAttachmentsProcessor' handles processing of attachments in HTML responses within Drupal, including rendering placeholders, managing asset libraries, and setting HTTP headers.

classes.name: HtmlResponseAttachmentsProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of attachments in HTML responses, including rendering placeholders, managing asset libraries, and setting HTTP headers.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Main method to process and embed attachments into the HTML response, including rendering placeholders and setting headers.

methods.name: formatHttpHeaderAttributes
methods.description: Formats an array of attributes into a string suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: renderPlaceholders
methods.description: Converts the response content into a render array, renders placeholders, and updates the response content.

methods.name: processAssetLibraries
methods.description: Processes asset libraries into renderable arrays for styles and scripts.

methods.name: renderHtmlResponseAttachmentPlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the response content with rendered asset variables.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers on the response object.

methods.name: processHtmlHead
methods.description: Ensures proper key/data order and defaults for HTML head items.

methods.name: processHtmlHeadLink
methods.description: Transforms html_head_link array into html_head and http_header arrays.

methods.name: processFeed
methods.description: Converts a feed attachment into an html_head_link attachment.
